# macOS command surface

`hx-agent` is built from source on macOS. The declaration below is the exact
command/option surface. `--help` is safe; `onboard` requests permissions and
`run` can capture activity. Never run those unattended on someone else's Mac.

`hx-agent-app` is a menu-bar application, not a CLI with options. Use its menu
to pair, grant permissions, pause or quit. The installer never launches it.
The separate `e2e-harness` build cannot request permissions or build in release.

```rust
#[derive(Parser)]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Command,
}
#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Command {
    Run {
        #[arg(long)]
        dry_run: bool,
        #[arg(long)]
        duration_s: Option<u64>,
    },
    Pair {
        link: String,
        /// Replace saved credentials; revoke this device's previous server token first when re-pairing.
        #[arg(long)]
        replace: bool,
    },
    Status,
    /// Recognize the foreground screen once; output text JSON only, without recording.
    ScreenText {
        /// Replay an existing image with its accessibility sample from a JSON record.
        #[arg(long)]
        replay: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    },
    Onboard,
    NmHost,
    InstallNmHost {
        #[arg(long)]
        extension_id: String,
    },
}
```
